summary: First full E2E run of CareerTrack BI. Backend: 33 pytest cases, 30 passed (auth/401, categories, applications CRUD+search+filter+status history+duplicate, assessments, interviews, resume upload/download/soft-delete via object storage, contacts/companies/reminders, activity, KPIs, analytics, prefs, exports, restore merge, data isolation verified with a 2nd seeded user). Frontend: cookie auth redirect, all pages, create flows via UI, resume upload+download, analytics filters/reset/period toggle, settings theme/currency/exports/restore, mobile nav all work. One HIGH bug: applications created from the UI form get status '' and application_date '' (form sends empty strings), which breaks KPIs, analytics, status badge and sorting.

critical.issue: FormDialog sets every field to '' at start, so payload has status:'' and application_date:''. Backend doc.setdefault() does not replace empty strings, so the saved app has an empty status and date. Result: status badge is blank, Applied column shows '—', and KPIs (Active, Awaiting, This Month), the analytics funnel/outcomes/over-time and date sort all leave the app out. Reproduced in UI: 'TEST_UI QA Engineer' was saved with status='' and application_date=''.

minor.issue: The user's search text goes into $regex without re.escape. Search 'C++ (' returns 500, and so does any job title containing + ( [ ? *.
When filters match 0 apps, app_ids is empty, so the condition `... or not app_ids` pulls in ALL assessments and interviews. Their stats are then shown for an empty filter.
date_to 'YYYY-MM-DD' parses to midnight, so apps later on that day are excluded (not inclusive of the selected end day).
user_preferences rows have no 'id', so the merge path always inserts. This creates duplicate preference docs per user (reproduced: 2 docs after one merge restore).
No status_history entry is created for the duplicate, and it keeps application_date and resume links from the original.
application_id ownership is not validated, so a user can link to another user's app id. Nothing leaks, but orphan records are created.

minor.endpoint: DELETE assessments/interviews, PUT/DELETE categories, PUT/DELETE resumes
minor.issue: These actions write no activity_log entry, so activity history is incomplete.
Sync `requests` is called inside async handlers and blocks the event loop. Uploads have a 120s timeout. Use httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool.
The session token is accepted as a query param, which risks leaking it through URLs and logs. The frontend uses blob + cookie, so this path can be removed.

ui_bugs.issue: No default for status (Applied) or application_date (today), so the status badge renders an empty grey pill (same root cause as the backend critical issue).

Navigates to /interviews?status=Completed, but the Interviews page ignores the query param. Also, 'Assessments Pending' links status=Pending while the KPI counts Received/Not Started/In Progress/Pending.
Renders only status history. The backend `timeline` (activity: assessment/interview added) is not shown.

integration_issues.issue: api.get('/analytics') and '/preferences' have no .catch/error state. A failed call leaves the skeleton loading forever.

issues: A single-category donut renders as an incomplete ring (gap from paddingAngle)
Native browser date and datetime-local pickers are used instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover

action_items: HIGH: Default status='Applied' and application_date=today in ApplicationForm initial values, AND in the backend treat empty-string status/application_date as missing (create + update)
Escape the search/company regex with re.escape in GET /api/applications (and company filter)
Analytics: when filters are active and match 0 apps, return empty assessment/interview stats. Make date_to inclusive (end of day)
Restore merge: upsert user_preferences by user_id instead of inserting
Validate application_id ownership on assessment/interview/reminder create
Interviews page: honour ?status= query param. Align the Assessments Pending KPI link
Add error handling to the analytics/preferences fetches
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1016 lines; split into routers (auth, applications, analytics, export)
Blocking `requests` calls inside async endpoints (storage + auth session exchange)
Generic CRUD accepts arbitrary Dict payloads with no Pydantic validation (mass-assignment of any field)
Category rename does not update the denormalized category_name on applications (search uses category_name)
datetime-local interview_date is stored without a timezone and the backend parses it as UTC

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all flows work; empty status/date bug affects KPIs and analytics)

test_credentials: Bearer/cookie session_token=test_session_satya (user_test_satya). A temp 2nd user user_test_other was created for the isolation test and removed.
seed_data_creation: All TEST data for user_test_satya was deleted after the run (applications, categories, companies, contacts, reminders, resumes, assessments, interviews). The prefs doc was kept with currency INR / theme dark. Activity logs remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_careertrack_api.py` (pytest.ini forces -n 2 loadscope; use -n 0 for serial). The 3 expected failures are regex 500, the analytics empty-filter leak, and the restore prefs dup. After the fix, check that the UI-created application shows the 'Applied' badge and counts in the Active/Awaiting/This Month KPIs and in analytics over-time. Also check the Interviews ?status param.
rca of the issue: Empty status/date: FormDialog useEffect initialises every field to '' (FormDialog.jsx line ~19). ApplicationForm sends all keys, and server.create_application uses doc.setdefault('status','Applied'), which is a no-op when the key exists with ''. Fix: give the form defaults, and/or in the backend `if not doc.get('status'): doc['status']='Applied'` (same for application_date).
